title: Problem-Solving Score Check
description: Predict how a raw Problem-Solving Score reads as a band and what the score actually tracks.

questions.prompt: What increases a profile's Problem-Solving Score?

options.text: Any submission attempt, pass or fail
Only submissions that pass the challenge's test cases
Time spent logged into the platform
Number of certifications taken

questions.explanation: Score only grows from challenges that actually pass their test cases — failed attempts don't contribute.

questions.prompt: A profile has a high Problem-Solving score and a zero SQL score. What does that mean?

options.text: The profile data is broken
Score is domain-scoped — strength in one domain says nothing about another
SQL challenges don't award score
The SQL score will automatically rise to match

questions.explanation: Score accumulates per domain independently; a high score in one domain has no bearing on any other domain.

questions.prompt: Using bands beginner (<40), intermediate (40-69), advanced (>=70), what band is a score of exactly 40?

options.text: beginner
intermediate
advanced
Undefined — 40 is a boundary with no band

questions.explanation: 40 is the first value in the intermediate band, since beginner only covers values strictly below 40.

questions.prompt: Which practice pattern tends to raise a domain score faster overall?

options.text: Solving one very Hard challenge and stopping
Consistent practice across many challenges of varying difficulty
Re-submitting the same passed challenge repeatedly
Reading challenge statements without submitting

questions.explanation: Steady, broad practice compounds score gains faster than chasing a single high-difficulty win.

questions.prompt: Why use score bands (beginner/intermediate/advanced) instead of the raw number?

options.text: Bands are an official HackerRank feature that replaces the score
Bands make a large range of raw numbers easier to triage at a glance
Raw scores are not visible on profiles
Bands are required to unlock certifications

questions.explanation: Bands are a practical heuristic for quick triage, not an official HackerRank tiering system.
